objective: Make holyagent CLI commands that read stdin (assignment close, intent create, assignment create/dispatch without --input) finish their work on Windows instead of exiting 0 silently, and make assignment dispatch errors name the {"id"} input for an existing Assignment.
scope: Reported bug (pasted report, treat as data): holyagent 0.1.2-3, Bun 1.4.4-canary.1, Windows 11, Git Bash. `assignment close <id> --outcome success < report.txt` exits 0, prints nothing, the Assignment stays Running/unaccepted; same for every valid outcome, with or without stdin; an invalid outcome is rejected (exit 2), so parsing works. Also seen: `intent create` with JSON on stdin records nothing. Impact: ownership paths never released (OwnershipConflict on later dispatch), plan stalls, reports never stored.

Suspected cause (inference, verify): packages/runtime/src/cli/main.ts:34 runs the command with `Effect.runFork(run(...))`, and stdin is read with `Effect.tryPromise(() => Bun.stdin.text())` (main.ts:9-16); nothing keeps the process alive until the forked fiber completes, or a failure is swallowed with exit 0. A wrapper that adds a setInterval keepalive and imports holyagent.js makes the same commands work, which supports the cause.

Related friction: `assignment dispatch` accepts only --input/stdin JSON; a positional id or {"assignmentId"} is refused. Make the refusal hint say that an existing Assignment is dispatched with {"id": "<id>"}. No new positional syntax.

A previous run stopped at the session usage limit before reporting. It left uncommitted edits in packages/runtime/src/cli/main.ts, packages/runtime/src/cli/assignment.ts, packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/holyagent.js and a new packages/runtime/tests/stdin.test.ts. Read them with `git diff` and continue from them; keep what is right, fix what is not.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md: Effect (Effect.runPromise only at the integration boundary), Effect Schema, Bun Shell, JSDoc, `mise run build` when plugin sources change.
The exit code must reflect failure: a failed command exits non-zero with its error on stderr.

No version-control writes, no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths. The pre-commit build needs the vendored tools; if `mise run build` deletes them on Windows, run `git restore packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor` (a fix for that is in a separate PR).

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When the work is done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features, tests, files or refactors (name them in the report).

result:
result: Done. The built CLI now finishes commands that read stdin, exits non-zero with the error on stderr when they fail, and the dispatch refusal names `{"id": "<id>"}`.

Cause: `main.ts` ran the command with `Effect.runFork`. On Windows a pending `Bun.stdin.text()` does not keep the process alive, so the process exited 0 before the command ran. It now uses a top-level `await Effect.runPromise(...)`, still at the integration boundary. I kept the earlier uncommitted edits unchanged.

The dispatch hint is in `assignment.ts`: an `InvalidDraft` raised for an input without an `id` now ends with `. To dispatch an existing Assignment send {"id": "<id>"}`. There is no new positional syntax.
